title: רב אהילאי
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Rav Ahilai was marrying off his son at Rav Yitzchak bar Shmuel bar Marta’s house (our reading has Rav Achai); see there. Bar Ahilai—some say Rav Yechezkel and Rav Yechiel—said in Shmuel’s name. I did not find it. See Rav Achli; it seems there is an error here. See Hilai: all are one.
